Therefore, the ''Lapiz Cutter'' was destroyed in 19 BBY. |retired= |affiliation=*[[Trade Federation]] *[[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] |navy=*[[Trade Federation fleet]] *[[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy]] |fleet= |owners=[[Nute Gunray]] |captains= |registry= |aliases= }} {{Quote|We have to get out of here.|Nute Gunray, to two battle droids on Rodia, as they were going towards the ''Lapiz Cutter''|}} The '''''Lapiz Cutter''''' was the personal [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] of [[Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray]]. It was used by Gunray during the Federation's [[Invasion of Naboo]] to [[transport]] him and [[Rune Haako]] to [[Theed]]. A [[Standard decade|decade]] later, the [[viceroy]] escaped from the [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] aboard the ''Lapiz Cutter'' during the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], the [[shuttle]] was pressed into [[Confederacy military|military]] service and carried Gunray on numerous missions, including [[Mission to Rodia|one]] to [[Rodia]]. The ''Lapiz Cutter'' was destroyed at the end of the war during the [[Lightsaber duel|lightsaber]] [[Duel on Mustafar|duel]] between [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. ==Description== The ''Lapiz Cutter'' was a ''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle used by Nute Gunray at least since the [[Invasion of Naboo]] until the end of the [[Clone Wars]]. It was produced by the [[Haor Chall Engineering Corporation]], having a length of 14.4 [[meter]]s, two engines and a door at the back.{{Film|I}} Its design resembled a [[Neimoidian soldier beetle]].''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' and the shuttle had a curved hull and landing gear that looked similar to pincers.''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' The ''Lapiz Cutter'' was unarmed, but was equipped with [[Deflector shield generator|shields]], short-range [[sensor]]s, a Class 1 [[hyperdrive]] and a backup Class 10 hyperdrive. It could achieve a maximum speed of 880 [[Kilometer per hour|kph]].''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]''— Based on corresponding data for [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttles]] ==History== {{Quote|Viceroy, we have captured the queen.''"
"''Ah, victory.|OOM-9 to Gunray after the latter and Rune Haako arrived on Naboo aboard the ''Lapiz Cutter''|}} In [[32 BBY]],{{FilmDate|I}} [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation|Viceroy]] Nute Gunray, [[Rune Haako]] and other [[Trade Federation]] officials traveled to the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] aboard the ''Lapiz Cutter'', after the planet had been invaded by [[B1-series battle droid|battle droids]]. Shortly after Gunray and Haako left the [[shuttle]], [[OOM-9]] told them that the [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen of Naboo]] had been captured. Gunray and Haako also left the planet aboard the shuttle after the battle there had ended. [[File:NeimoidianGroundCrewmen.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ''Lapiz Cutter'' on Geonosis in 22 BBY]] Ten [[Standard year|years]] later, in [[22 BBY]],{{FilmDate|II}} a [[First Battle of Geonosis|large-scale battle]], the first of the Clone Wars, took place on [[Geonosis]] and the [[viceroy]] left the planet aboard the ''Lapiz Cutter''.{{Film|II}} That same year, the shuttle would be repainted in grey and blue, the colors of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and would take Nute Gunray to the planet [[Rodia]] so he could oversee the [[Death|execution]] of [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], after she had been captured by battle droids with the help of Senator [[Onaconda Farr]]. A [[Mission to Rodia|battle]] started on the planet when [[Jar Jar Binks]] went to help Senator Amidala escape and the viceroy went to the shuttle to leave, but it was pushed into a [[swamp]] by a [[Bogey (Kwazel Maw)|Kwazel Maw]].{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}} Gunray had the [[Starship|vessel]] recovered afterwards due to his attachment to it. At the end of the war, in [[19 BBY]], the ''Lapiz Cutter'' transported Gunray to [[Mustafar]], and during the [[Lightsaber duel|lightsaber]] [[Duel on Mustafar|duel]] between [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the shuttle was destroyed when the shields that protected much of the [[Magma|lava]] [[mining]] operation were shut down, destroying the [[Hangar|landing pad]] where the ''Lapiz Cutter'' was stationed. ==Behind the scenes== The ''Lapiz Cutter'' first appeared in the movie [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which was released on [[May 19]], [[1999]].''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]'' It also appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], which premiered on [[May 12]], [[2002]].{{ThisWeek|u0Z7i0LnXOg|Mandalorian Season 2 Directors, We Celebrate a Birthday, and More!|sw_url=video/mandalorian-season-2-directors-we-celebrate-a-birthday-and-more}} On [[November 21]] [[2008]],{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode008.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Bombad Jedi}} it appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Bombad Jedi]]". The shuttle was designed during production for ''The Phantom Menace'' by [[Industrial Light & Magic|ILM]] employees [[Larry Tan]] and [[Adam Savage]] who also worked on ''[[Wikipedia:Mythbusters|Mythbusters]]''.{{YouTube|video=XGFSn2Xm8ks|text=Ask Adam Savage: "Did You Ever Meet George Lucas?"|channel=@tested|name=Adam Savage's Tested|date=2020-05-24}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of the Lapiz Cutter}} *''[[Star Wars: The Prequel Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} *{{Film|II}} *{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}} ==Sources== *{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode008.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Bombad Jedi}} *{{SWE|technology|neimoidianshuttle|Neimoidian escort shuttle}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/bombad-jedi-episode-guide|text="Bombad Jedi" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} *{{BuildFalconCite|54|Starship Fact File}} {{1stID|''Lapiz Cutter''}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Miscellaneous Ships and Vehicles (2)}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Lápiz Cortador }} [[Category:Sheathipede-class transport shuttles]] [[Category:Starships of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Starships of the Trade Federation]]
